description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, which represents attachment data related to claims in the Human Resource Management system. It uses Doctrine ORM mapping annotations for database interactions and includes properties such as attachment ID, description, filename, attachment data, file type, associated user, and attachment time.

classes.name: ClaimAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim attachment, mapped to the 'ohrm_claim_attachment' database table, with fields for ID, description, filename, file data, user, and timestamp.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment content or resource.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who uploaded the attachment.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the attachment was added.
